summary.text: Jeff Dotseth is a Republican state representative from Minnesota who has represented House District 11A since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner, his career experience includes owning Jeff Dotseth & Associates Realty.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Dotseth's career experience includes owning Jeff Dotseth & Associates Realty.
He served as a director of the Minnesota Association of Realtors.
Dotseth took office in the Minnesota House of Representatives on January 3, 2023, succeeding Mike Sundin.
The Republican primary for his seat on August 11, 2026, was canceled.
